reviewed_by: Codex review of the Ask Nebula native-browser visibility change
reason: The selection covers the changed desktop presentation boundary: the WorkbenchBrowser component and the catalogued native-scope-status desktop journey verify that opening, hiding, restoring, and closing Ask Nebula no longer hides the live native browser. A production build validates the removed context and prop plumbing.
exclusions: No Python, Rust, Core persistence, provider, harness, streaming, reconnect, mobile layout, or origin-sensitive behavior changed. The native browser integration is desktop-only; mobile Chromium/WebKit, real-Core, LAN-origin, physical-device, full-suite, and unrelated Playwright journeys are excluded.
